messages:
Rachael (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — wanted to open a thread for any follow-up q's about the headcount plan and org changes. i'll check in through the day.
Anya (People Ops): thanks rachael. first question from me: does the headcount shift affect regional hiring targets? eg, do we reallocate roles from na -> apac? :globe_with_meridians:
Rachael (CEO): short answer: some rebalancing. we committed to increase APAC footprint for 2026 but not by canceling critical NA hires. we'll prioritize customer-facing Dedicated roles where demand is strongest. detailed regional allocation in the hiring tracker.
Jules (CTO): to add — we're creating a small "Serving Core" grouping (runtime, kernel ops, perf) to centralize scarce-skill hires and reduce duplicated interviews. folks staying on current squads, but hiring & leveling for those roles will route through the core group.
Priya (Eng Manager): does this mean hiring managers will lose interview loop control? worried about longer time-to-offer.
Marco (Recruiter): good question. process change = centralized requisition review + shared interview panel for specialized ICs. SLA: we expect no more than one extra week in time-to-offer for Serving Core roles. we'll monitor.
Tasha (IC): any change to contractor conversions? i was planning to convert an SDET contractor in Q2.
Anya (People Ops): contractor conversions that are headcount-neutral or replace departing FT are fine. net-new conversions will go through the same freeze review. reach out to me or Marco for exceptions.
Rachael (CEO): also adding: hiring freeze = temporary roadblock for non-critical net-new roles. we will continue to backfill people leaving and proceed with high-impact hires (dedicated sales eng, runtime, reliability, private-launch PMs).
Priya (Eng Manager): ok — can we get the canonical list of greenlit roles? would save a lot of back-and-forth.
Anya (People Ops): yes — uploading the canonical sheet now: https://drive.redwood.example/hiring-q2/greenlist-2026-03-23. it includes role id, team, region, reason, and owner.
NotesBot: Meeting notes and slides uploaded: https://meetings.redwood.example/allhands-2026-03-23/notes.pdf
Marco (Recruiter): i'll post a recruiter-run tracker with pipelines for all approved roles and assigned sourcers. managers: if you want to move a req up, add a one-line justification to the greenlist doc and tag @Marco.
Tasha (IC): what about leveling/grading for the Serving Core? some of our senior engineers will be on-call for interviews. any compensation changes?
Jules (CTO): leveling stays the same. Serving Core will centralize calibration to make offers more consistent across regions. comp bands unchanged; exceptions for rarity can be escalated.
Rachael (CEO): side note on org structure: no mass reorganizations this quarter. small matrix leads for cross-team infra coordination may be added, but people keep their primary reporting lines.
Anya (People Ops): i will schedule a hiring managers sync tomorrow 9am PT to walk through the greenlist and conversion rules. invite sent.
Priya (Eng Manager): thanks — i'll bring the backlog of reqs and top referrals.
Marco (Recruiter): quick ask — encourage employees to refer senior ICs via the referral form; roles with urgent need will have doubled referral bonuses this month. link: https://jobs.redwood.example/referrals
Tasha (IC): :thumbsup: will share. also can folks confirm whether internship hiring proceeds? we rely on interns for summer projects.
Anya (People Ops): internships proceed; campus hiring remains on. intern converts are handled case-by-case but generally treated as backfills or prioritized if tied to product launches.
Rachael (CEO): final recap: freeze is short & scoped, priority to customer-impacting infra and Dedicated/Private launch roles, Serving Core created for scarce skills to streamline hiring, regional rebalancing but no wholesale cancellations, managers please use the greenlist doc and tag Marco/Anya for exceptions.
Priya (Eng Manager): appreciated. will review the greenlist and add our reqs.
Marco (Recruiter): i'll DM hiring leads with timelines and next steps.
Anya (People Ops): if anyone has confidential concerns about headcount or transfers, please DM me.
Rachael (CEO): thanks all. closing the thread in a few hours — will re-open if new items surface. :handshake:
